conservative.requirements: Favour equal to the severity value of a critical wound you have suffered (see below). Special: When you suffer a critical wound, you may immediately spend favour equal to the severity value of that wound and place a number of recharge tokens equal to the severity value +2 on this card to invoke this blessing. The wound is converted to a normal wound.
